title: Simple Sleep
description: A simple, lightweight and fast plugin to skip the nights
body:
Simple plugin for Paper/Spigot that allows you to skip nights and deactivate phantoms

❇️​ This plugin belongs to the [Simple Plugins](https://modrinth.com/collection/NkfcCoA2) collection, check out other similar and compatible plugins here

## Features
- **Skip the night using various methods**
  - **By percentage:** Night skips when a percentage of users are sleeping
  - **One player sleep:** Only one sleeping player is needed to skip the night
  - **Auto Skip:** Automatically skip when night falls
- **Allows users to sleep on the floor** (optional)
- **Enable/disable phantom generation**
- System to ignore **AFK** players (requires EssentialsX)
- Personalized messages with color support
- Configurable prefix for all plugin messages

## Commands
- **/sleep** To sleep on the floor
- **/sleep toggle** Toggle sleep gamerule on/off
- **/sleep autoskip** Toggle auto-skip night on/off
- **/sleep phantoms** Toggle doInsomnia (phantoms on/off)
- **/sleep reload** Reload configuration

## Permissions
- **ssleep.sleep:** Allows to use /sleep
- **ssleep.toggle:** Allows to use /sleep toggle
- **ssleep.toggle.autoskip:** Allows to use /sleep autoskip
- **ssleep.phantoms:** Allows to use /sleep phantoms
- **ssleep.reload:** Allows to use /sleep reload

## Configuration & Requirements

For more information on configuration and requirements, [visit the plugin GitHub](https://github.com/sardidefcon/simple-sleep) page
